Title: Reload Data command (DataReloadCommand)
Description: Parent issue. Ribbon button on the Kelly Tools tab, General panel, that reloads the Kelly CSV data files from the add-in's Data folder after a new export, without restarting Revit. Asks before loading an export older than the cached one; on any problem it keeps the current data. Repos: Kelly-Revit-v4, Kelly-Revit-Logic-v4, Kelly-Windows-Data-v2.

Title: Remove the SQL-based "Reload SQL Data" recache
Description: Remove AllServerDataRecachePushButton, AllServerDataRecacheCommand, its Updater panel entry and App.ReloadData(), as part of dropping SQL Server from the add-in. Keep the DatabaseDownload icons (used by three other buttons). Kelly-Revit-v4 commits a95c224, 886c0b2.

Title: Load every data file once at startup into App.Data (DataStore)
Description: New Application.Services.DataStore built in OnStartup before the application services start: typed lists plus dictionary indexes, behind a "Loading Data Files" progress bar with one step per file. This is what the reload refills. Kelly-Revit-v4 commits 97fef5e, 6f541be, 3fdc4ec, e66c49a.

Title: Share one load path: App.LoadDataFiles() for startup and the button
Description: Move the startup load into App.LoadDataFiles() so startup and Reload Data run the same check, load and error dialog. Replace App.Data only after every file loaded; otherwise keep the old data and show the "Kelly Tools For Revit Data Error" dialog. Kelly-Revit-v4 commit 63c2d53.

Title: Add the button label in Kelly-Revit-Logic and repin
Description: Names.PushButtonText: RecacheSqlDataDatabase became ReloadJsonData ("Reload JSON Data", package 4.26.1021.1856), then ReloadData ("Reload Data", package 4.26.1022.819) once the data could be CSV. Pack Logic and repin Kelly-Revit-v4 each time.

Title: Create DataReloadCommand and DataReloadPushButton
Description: Documents/Commands/MultiTrade/DataReload: DataReloadCommand (CoreCommand, IExternalCommandBase, TransactionMode.Manual) calls App.LoadDataFiles() and returns Cancelled when nothing loaded, so Revit shows no failure of its own. DataReloadPushButton with the DatabaseDownload 16/32 icons, tooltip and command type. Register it on the ribbon. Kelly-Revit-v4 commit 63c2d53.

Title: Read the data files through manifest.json and allow CSV
Description: Read each file through its manifest.json entry instead of by .json name (EndPreparationsWelded via ReadAll), so a Kelly-Data-Exporter --format csv export loads with no other change. Progress bar steps drop the .json suffix. Pins Kelly.Windows.Data 4.26.1022.815. Kelly-Revit-v4 commit 3aa3c7e.

Title: Refuse non-CSV data files
Description: The data check run by startup and Reload Data reports every manifest.json entry that is not .csv and stops startup or keeps the current data. Rollout note: install this build in every Revit year before the first CSV export. Kelly-Revit-v4 commit 97f523a; later 333c88c gives DataDirectory only the CSV reader.

Title: Validate the export in one pass: row counts and SHA-256
Description: DataStore.Load reads manifest.json once, checks each file's row count and SHA-256 against the manifest, and refuses a truncated, mixed or edited export. Logs the export time, server, databases and user on every load. Pins Kelly.Windows.Data 4.26.1022.912. Kelly-Revit-v4 commits 1b1cf0d, 4a84834.

Title: Ask before loading an export older than the cached data
Description: Compare the folder's manifest ExportedUtc with App.Data.Manifest before reading any file. If older, a "Kelly Tools For Revit Data" dialog shows both exports and asks to load anyway (No is the default); a decline is logged. Startup never asks. DataStore.Load takes an optional accept check. Dialog wording revised three times. Kelly-Revit-v4 commits cfc2a86, a5796b3, 6362eba, beb56a2.

Title: Move Reload Data to the General panel
Description: Move the button from the Updater panel to the General panel, third from the left after About and Project Directory (GeneralRibbonPanelConfiguration).

Title: Rewrite the tooltip from what the command does
Description: Tooltip: reloads the Kelly data files from the Data folder after a new export without restarting Revit; asks first if the files are older; keeps the current data on a problem. Texts no longer mention SQL Server or JSON. Kelly-Revit-v4 commits 6601016, 8244137.

Title: Build, install and test Reload Data in Revit
Description: Build 2024, 2025 and 2026 with 0 errors. Installed for 2024 (4.26.1022.949, later 1410) and tested: all 23 files loaded with hashes and row counts checked, reload took 1.56 s, an older export (15:37 UTC vs 16:50 UTC) was declined and logged, no Kelly errors. Installed for 2025 and 2026 but not yet run there.

Title: Document Reload Data: Changelog, README, test checklist
Description: Changelog entries with dated headings and build versions, README, XML docs on DataReloadCommand and LoadDataFiles, and the Reload Data entry in "KTR v4 Command Test Checklist.md" (Enabled: Always).

Title: Run Reload Data in Revit 2025 and 2026
Description: The command is installed for 2025 and 2026 but has only been run in Revit 2024. Run it there: normal reload, older-export decline, and a broken export (missing file) that must keep the current data.

Title: Refresh cached definition sets after Reload Data
Description: DefinitionSetCache<T> is a static Lazy<T>; its definition sets (NestedDefinitionSet, JhkBillOfMaterialDefinitionSet) call App.GetDefinition only when first built, so after a reload they keep the old parameter definitions until Revit restarts. Reset them (and any other static cache built from App.Data) when LoadDataFiles swaps App.Data.

Title: Guard Reload Data while other tools use App.Data
Description: Nothing stops a reload while an updater or modeless window is working; code holding the old DataStore keeps reading old data. Decide whether to block the reload, warn, or document it.

Title: Confirm a successful reload to the user
Description: The command returns Succeeded silently. Show a short message such as "Loaded 23 files exported <date> by <user>" so the user knows the reload took effect.
